changes: Added an early storyDir-inside-gitRoot detection helper (id-dependent evaluateStoryDirInsideGitRoot + id-independent TOTAL evaluateStoryDirConfigInsideGitRoot) in core/story-signed-workspace-resolution.ts, a lattice doctor storyDir/gitRoot scan, and a warn-only advisory at story_create + session_brief. Purely additive; the two late guards (worktree.ts:754, cli-engine.ts:3367) left untouched.
usage: Run lattice doctor (or story_create / session_brief) on a project; if storyDir resolves outside the resolved gitRoot you now get an early flagged check + remediation instead of failing late at INIT_CHECK worktree bootstrap.
expectedOutcome: doctor prints a ✗ storyDir resolves OUTSIDE the resolved gitRoot block with both absolute paths + remediation on a wrapper-root project; a ✓ healthy line in the normal case; the advisory is warn-only and never blocks story_create.
actualTranscript: On a synthetic wrapper-root fixture, node dist/cli.js doctor printed the ✗ block (storyDir=/private/tmp/wrfix-b198c/.lattice/story/actives, gitRoot=/private/tmp/wrfix-b198c/repo) + remediation; on this repo it printed ✓ resolves inside. Full capture in evidence/transcript-diff.md; lattice validate GREEN with the 20-check suite.
outcomeDiff: Match — actual output equals the PLAN outcome verbatim, and the normal case shows no false positive.
limitations: Detection + advisory only (decision Option A: warn, not hard-fail); the two late guards remain the hard backstop. Does not auto-relocate storyDir.
pitfalls: The global lattice binary runs the MAIN-repo dist, so to observe worktree changes you must build + run the worktree dist (node packages/main/dist/cli.js). The id-dependent helper throws if the story id metadata is absent — id-less callers must use the total config variant.
